clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for controlling design data and subsequent changes so that only current, correct, and approved design data is used.
The PAH must have procedures for controlling quality system documents and data, and their changes, ensuring that only current, correct, and approved documents are used.

The PAH must have procedures that ensure each supplier-provided product, article, or service conforms to PAH requirements and that establish a supplier-reporting process for released items later found nonconforming.
The PAH must have procedures for controlling manufacturing processes to ensure every product and article conforms to its approved design.
typical_evidence: first article and in-process inspection plans

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for inspections and tests used to ensure that each product and article conforms to its approved design, including a flight test of each aircraft produced unless exported unassembled and a functional test of each aircraft engine and each propeller produced, as applicable.

The PAH must have procedures to ensure calibration and control of all inspection, measuring, and test equipment used to determine conformity, with calibration standards traceable to a standard acceptable to the FAA.
typical_evidence: equipment master list with calibration status

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for documenting the inspection and test status of products and articles supplied or manufactured to the approved design.

The PAH must have procedures to ensure that only conforming products and articles are installed on type-certificated products. Procedures must provide for identification, documentation, evaluation, segregation, and disposition of nonconforming items, with disposition determinations made only by authorized individuals, and must ensure discarded articles are rendered unusable.
typical_evidence: evidence that scrapped articles are made unusable

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for implementing corrective and preventive actions to eliminate causes of actual or potential nonconformities to the approved design or noncompliance with the approved quality system.
typical_evidence: corrective action records with root cause

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures to prevent damage and deterioration of each product and article during handling, storage, preservation, and packaging.

The PAH must have procedures for identifying, storing, protecting, retrieving, and retaining quality records, retaining them for at least 5 years for products and articles and at least 10 years for critical components identified under §45.15(c).

The PAH must have procedures for planning, conducting, and documenting internal audits to ensure compliance with the approved quality system, including reporting audit results to the manager responsible for implementing corrective and preventive actions.
typical_evidence: management review inputs and CAPAs from audits

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for receiving and processing feedback on in-service failures, malfunctions, and defects, including a process to assist the design approval holder in addressing in-service problems and determining if changes to the Instructions for Continued Airworthiness are needed.
typical_evidence: ICA revision records driven by in-service data

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for identifying, analyzing, and initiating appropriate corrective action for products or articles released from the quality system that do not conform to applicable design data or quality system requirements.
typical_evidence: linkage between escapes and CAPA system

clauses.requirement_text: The PAH must have procedures for issuing authorized release documents for aircraft engines, propellers, and articles, covering selection, appointment, training, management, and removal of authorized individuals, and for complying with applicable export procedures and exporter responsibilities when release documents are issued for export.
typical_evidence: list of authorized signatories with training records
examples of correctly completed release documents
export documentation showing alignment with §§21.331 and 21.335
